questions.question: Describe the pattern on a butterfly's wings using a maths word.
questions.expected_answer: The wings have a line of symmetry down the middle of the body. One wing is a reflection, or mirror image, of the other.

questions.question: A brick wall is made of rectangles. Describe its pattern using maths words.
questions.expected_answer: The rectangles tessellate with no gaps and no overlaps. Each row is a translation of the row two below it.

questions.question: Describe a rondavel using 3D objects.
questions.expected_answer: A rondavel has walls shaped like a cylinder and a roof shaped like a cone.
